name: fused-mcp-shared-runtime
description: Shared MCP runtime exposing exactly search_docs and execute for Engine-managed MCP apps.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild dist/server.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/bundle.js && esbuild dist/metadata.js --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --global-name=FusedMetadata --target=es2018 --outfile=dist/metadata-bundle.js
